title: A Inventory for the Interior
author: Mirabel Eastwick
blurb: Paloma Okafor, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
